mapper.select: SELECT FROM research_notes WHERE workspace_key = #{workspace} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

INSERT INTO research_notes (id, workspace_key, research_id, title, markdown, citations) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspace}, #{researchId}, #{title}, #{markdown}, CAST(#{citations} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (workspace_key, research_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING , markdown, citations

UPDATE research_notes SET title = #{title}, markdown = #{markdown}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE workspace_key = #{workspace} AND id = #{id} AND revision = #{revision} RETURNING , markdown, citations
